book.title: Boost.Math 1.92.0: the Airy relative-error sentence
book.description: The Airy sentence from the Boost.Math documentation, carried as measured rows over the deposited witness data. The sentence is hedged ('in general') and states a relative bound of 100 epsilon for x > 0. The data are the witness rerun's 60-digit mpmath reference and the MSVC binary64 evaluations; claimgate recomputes every error exactly from the raw measured bits and the reference decimal, and cross-checks its result against the deposited error_eps column.
